source: Electricity Regulatory Authority (ERA): UEDCL end-user tariffs for Q3 2026, held unchanged for Q4 2026
per: kWh (one unit), VAT and any fixed charges not included
notes: Update every quarter from ERA's tariff schedules (https://www.era.go.ug/tariff-schedules/). The lifeline price applies to the first 15 units for homes whose six-month average use is 100 units a month or less; the cooking price applies to units 81 to 150 for customers registered for it.
